description: Parent refusal to provide consent caused delayed evaluation or initial services.
Parent repeatedly failed to produce the student for the evaluation.

The student transferred in from another district after the consent was obtained and the evaluation had begun but not yet been completed by the sending school district, including a determination of eligibility.
Student was referred to Part C less than 90 days prior to student's third birthday.
Transition planning meeting convened by Part C did not occur at least 90 days prior to student's 3rd birthday.
Referred to Part B less than 90 days prior to the student's third birthday.
Parent and district agreed to extend the evaluation timeline per the requirements of WAC 392-172A-03005(c), and the agreement is documented in writing.
